Secretary of State Marco Rubio Remarks to Press at Donald J. Trump Institute of Peace

Secretary of State Marco Rubio Remarks to Press at Donald J. Trump Institute of Peace

Remarks to the Press

Marco Rubio, Secretary of State

December 4, 2025

SECRETARY RUBIO:

Thank you. On security cooperation, we want to build on what was signed today.

QUESTION:

Mr. Secretary, Secretary Rubio, a question on the timeline?

SECRETARY RUBIO:

We will move as fast as the parties allow.
